entity_raw.definition_raw:
You draw on the strength of numbers and your shared convictions to intimidate your foes.

Prerequisite(s): Half-orc, intimidating racial trait.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use the Intimidate skill to demoralize foes, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your check for every ally who also has this feat within 30 feet (maximum +6).
